candidates: When using `.forEach()`, ensure the callback does not implicitly return a value from an assignment expression (e.g., `arr.forEach(([k, v]) => (x = x.replace(k, v)))`). Use a block-body arrow function (`([k, v]) => { x = x.replace(k, v); }`) or a `for...of` loop instead. This project's Biome configuration enforces `lint/suspicious/useIterableCallbackReturn`, which flags such patterns.
